_help: Config for the 'Share Photos & Videos' button inside the Ministry Outreach & Highlights call-out on news.html. Primary path is a Google Form with a file-upload question (all submissions land in our own Google Drive + a Responses spreadsheet with who/what/when). Paste the form's share URL into 'formUrl'. If you'd rather skip the Google sign-in step and let anyone drop files straight into a shared folder, paste that folder URL into 'uploadUrl' instead — but the form is the recommended default. The button stays hidden on the site until one of the two URLs is configured. See admin-help.html for the full walkthrough.
